details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The predicted answer changes the title’s final word from the gold target’s singular “spectrum” to the plural “spectra,” so it does not give the stated thesis title.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [1] identifies the 1939 doctoral thesis title as “Effect of Chemical Combination on X-Ray Emission Spectra.”
2. The gold target gives the title as “Effect of chemical combination on x-ray emission spectrum.”
3. The titles differ in the final word: the citation says “Spectra,” while the gold target says “spectrum.” Since this is part of the specific title, the cited passage does not support every non-trivial detail in the gold target.
